7:15 וְהַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נֶהְפַּךְ לְנָחָשׁ is the rod that became a נָחָשׁ in Moses' hand (EXO 4:3), while Aaron's became a תַּנִּין (7:10); 7:17 is the same rod 'in my hand'; in 7:20 וַיָּרֶם בַּמַּטֶּה follows 7:19's order to Aaron while EXO 17:5 calls it Moses' rod 'wherewith thou smotest the river', and the text does not settle whose
